verdict.rationale: Solid documents fine-grained updates: only the code that depends on a changed piece of state reruns, components run once, and dependencies are tracked automatically. Community users confirm the surgical, high-performance DOM updates and credit dom-expressions. The compiler side is only implied, by the 'jsx: preserve' / jsxImportSource config and the dom-expressions mention, and no item explicitly describes a compiler turning components into targeted DOM operations. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the compiler/JSX transform and how it emits surgical DOM updates, plus hands-on evidence tying compiler output to update efficiency.
